units.text: In Career, this chapter favours a team of equals over a ladder of bosses, and you find your footing among people who work at your level.
In Wealth, this chapter favours money you earn with your own hands over money handed to you, and you trust a pay packet you can point to.
In Wealth, this chapter favours a shared pot over a private one, and you lose less when a friend looks over the figures before you spend.
In Love, this chapter favours a partner who stands beside you over one who stands in front, and you grow surer of your own place in the pair.
In Love, this chapter favours a partner with a strong will of their own over one who agrees, and you soften once you meet your match.
At home, this chapter favours holding your own corner over keeping everyone happy, and you speak up for what you need at the table.
With friends, this chapter favours peers who challenge you over people who admire you, and you gain nerve from every friendly contest.
With friends, this chapter favours teamwork over rivalry, and you get more from a circle once you no longer need to win each round.
In Health, this chapter favours building stamina over spending it, and you wake with more in reserve after a steady run of early nights.
In Health, this chapter favours hard exercise over sitting still, and you sleep best on days that burn off the extra force.
In your thinking, this chapter favours your own judgement over borrowed opinions, and you back a decision without checking it with everyone first.
In your thinking, this chapter favours a second view over your first instinct, and you change your mind more gracefully than you used to.
In Growth, this chapter favours hard tests over safe lessons, and you come out of each one with a firmer sense of yourself.
In Career, this chapter favours a mentor over a bigger title, and you learn the trade from someone who wants you to succeed.
In Career, this chapter favours doing the work over preparing for it, and you discover that you already know enough to begin.
In Wealth, this chapter favours slow learning over quick gains, and you earn more once you understand where your money goes.
In Wealth, this chapter favours acting on a plan over studying it, and you gain more from one real step than from another month of reading.
In Love, this chapter favours a partner who looks after you over one who dazzles, and you let yourself be cared for without keeping score.
In Love, this chapter favours doing things together over talking things through, and you feel closest to a partner on a shared walk.
At home, this chapter favours a quiet household over a busy one, and you find the shelter you have wanted for a long time.
At home, this chapter favours looking after others over being looked after, and you gain strength from the jobs you take off someone's hands.
With friends, this chapter favours an older friend with good advice over a crowd, and you lean on one or two people who see you clearly.
With friends, this chapter favours making plans over mulling them over, and you are the one who books the table and turns up first.
In Health, this chapter favours early nights over late ones, and you gather strength from long sleeps and slow mornings.
In Health, this chapter favours moving over lying low, and you feel brighter after a brisk walk than after another lie-in.
In your thinking, this chapter favours study over hurry, and you take in more from books and teachers than in any earlier stretch.
In your thinking, this chapter favours one clear choice over endless weighing, and you settle questions faster than your old habit of doubt allowed.
In Growth, this chapter favours a course or a teacher over going it alone, and you pick up a skill that pays you back for years.
In Growth, this chapter favours practice over theory, and you learn more from one real attempt than from a shelf of advice.
In Career, this chapter favours work that shows your talent over work that hides it, and you get noticed for something you made yourself.
In Career, this chapter favours a clear brief over a free hand, and you do your finest work inside limits someone else has set.
In Wealth, this chapter favours earning from a skill over earning by the hour, and you turn something you enjoy into income.
In Wealth, this chapter favours saving over treating yourself, and you keep more when pleasure waits until the end of the month.
In Love, this chapter favours a partner who laughs with you over one who keeps things serious, and you show your affection more openly than before.
In Love, this chapter favours hearing a partner out over making your point, and you win more warmth by asking than by telling.
At home, this chapter favours cooking and making things together over keeping the place tidy, and you fill the house with your own touches.
At home, this chapter favours a kind word over a sharp one, and you keep the household calm by holding back the first reply.
With friends, this chapter favours a lively table over a quiet evening in, and you become the one who gets everyone talking.
With friends, this chapter favours a smaller audience over a bigger one, and you are trusted more when you share less.
In Health, this chapter favours good food and play over strict routines, and you recover your energy through the things you enjoy.
In Health, this chapter favours a steady appetite over feasts, and you sleep better on evenings when you switch off early and say little.
In your thinking, this chapter favours ideas you can make real over ideas you only hold, and you think best with a pen in your hand.
In your thinking, this chapter favours one finished idea over ten half-formed ones, and you give your best thought the time it needs to ripen.
In Growth, this chapter favours a creative craft over a safe qualification, and you grow most through something you can show to others.
In Growth, this chapter favours patient mastery over quick display, and you go further by polishing one talent than by showing many.
